author: Slavcho Ivanov and the GEMBA IT team

excerpt.en: Fifteen months of building, rebuilding, and refusing to quit: GembaTicket is a modern web3 ticketing platform where the blockchain is invisible, the fees are zero, and organizers get paid the moment a ticket sells.
excerpt.bg: Петнайсет месеца строене, престрояване и отказ да се предам: GembaTicket е модерна web3 платформа за билети, където блокчейнът е невидим, таксите са нула, а организаторите получават парите в мига, в който се продаде билет.
excerpt.es: Quince meses construyendo, reconstruyendo y sin rendirme: GembaTicket es una plataforma web3 moderna de entradas donde el blockchain es invisible, las comisiones son cero y los organizadores cobran en el momento en que se vende una entrada.

title.bg: Как да поправите ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE в node-fetch

excerpt.en: Node's June 2026 security release made node-fetch throw ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE on keep-alive sockets. Here is the hidden trap and the fix.
excerpt.bg: Юнският security release на Node за 2026 г. накара node-fetch да хвърля ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE по keep-alive сокети. Ето го скрития капан и поправката.
excerpt.es: El security release de Node de junio de 2026 hizo que node-fetch lanzara ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE en sockets keep-alive. Aquí la trampa oculta y la solución.

excerpt.en: After years on paper, Permitiv is in development: a permit-to-work and safety platform for refineries, shipyards and heavy industry, built with real crews.

title.en: Why Your Postgres Pool Runs Out

excerpt.en: Everyone says add a connection pool to protect Postgres. The default node-postgres pool, multiplied across your instances, is what takes Postgres down. Here is the whole class of failures and the fixes.

title.en: Stripe Idempotency Keys Break After Login

excerpt.en: Your Stripe checkout works for guests, then fails with a 400 idempotency_error the moment someone logs in. Here is why a static key breaks — and the one-line fix.
Upgrade to Hardhat 3 and your CommonJS config dies with HHE13. Hardhat 3 is ESM-only — here is the cascade that breaks, and how to migrate cleanly.

title.en: Why viem Multicall Eats Revert Reasons

excerpt.en: Enable batch.multicall in viem and contract reverts stop telling you why. The revert bytes are still there on the error chain — just never decoded. Here is the trap and the three ways out.
CVE-2026-6638: until PostgreSQL 18.4, REFRESH PUBLICATION built SQL from subscriber table names without quoting them. Here is how the trust boundary slipped, and what to do.

title.en: Why isContract() Now Lies About EOAs

excerpt.en: After EIP-7702, a delegated EOA has 23 bytes of code starting with 0xef0100. Every Solidity contract still using isContract() now lies about humans.

Solidity 0.8.35 added an erc7201 comptime builtin that ends a real footgun: hand-typed namespace slot constants in upgradeable contracts. Here is what was breaking, and the new one-liner that fixes it.

title.es: Por qué pool.query('BEGIN') corrompe tus datos

excerpt.en: A pool.query('BEGIN') / pool.query('COMMIT') transaction passes every test and silently spreads across two clients in production. Here is the race, and the one-pattern fix the node-postgres docs hide in a single sentence.
excerpt.bg: Транзакция с pool.query('BEGIN') / pool.query('COMMIT') минава всеки тест и тихо се разпростира между два клиента в production. Ето я race condition-а и едноредовия fix, който документацията на node-postgres крие в едно изречение.
excerpt.es: Una transacción pool.query('BEGIN') / pool.query('COMMIT') pasa todos los tests y se propaga silenciosamente entre dos clientes en producción. Aquí está la race condition y la solución de una línea que la documentación de node-postgres esconde en una sola frase.

title.bg: Race condition в идемпотентността на Stripe webhook-овете
title.es: Race condition de idempotencia en webhooks de Stripe

excerpt.en: A SELECT-then-INSERT idempotency check passes every test and still double-charges in production. Here is the race, and the one-line Postgres pattern that fixes it.
excerpt.bg: Проверка за идемпотентност чрез SELECT-после-INSERT минава всеки тест и въпреки това удвоява таксуването в production. Ето я race condition-а и едноредовия Postgres pattern, който я решава.
excerpt.es: Una verificación de idempotencia con SELECT-luego-INSERT pasa todos los tests y aún así cobra doble en producción. Aquí está la race condition y el patrón Postgres de una línea que la soluciona.

excerpt.es: SOL-2026-1 reemplaza silenciosamente sstore por tstore en solc 0.8.28–0.8.33. Aquí está cómo funciona la colisión de caché del helper Yul y cómo demostrar que tu recompilación es segura.
